outcome.answer: For wordy or repetitive student-generated rollouts in on-policy distillation, StableOPD directly targets repetition-induced length inflation using a reference-based divergence constraint and rollout-mixture distillation [1]. Another approach aligns functionally equivalent EOS tokens to reduce termination-mismatch-driven length inflation, though this does not eliminate all late-training inflation [2]. For verbose reasoning traces, BIRD first trains on concise, answer-correct samples and then applies on-policy distillation with a concise self-teacher [5].
